title: Termwise change of rings of a cochain complex
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site, $\varphi:R\to S$ a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings, and $K$ a cochain complex of $R$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Its termwise change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] is the cochain complex $K\otimes_R S$ of $S$-modules with term $(K\otimes_R S)^i=K^i\otimes_R S$ and differential $d^i\otimes_R 1$. The change-of-rings maps preserve zero and composition, so these differentials have cochain shape and square to zero.
